scope: Independent source review of root automation integration and exchange implementation custody. No UI or hardware verification; no Cubase runtime conformance claim.
status: No actionable integration defect identified in validated domain.
checks: Project validates lane identities and at most one lane per gainDB/pan parameter before preparation.
Offline preparation queries automation at (rounded clip startFrame+frame)/project sampleRate, matching actual scheduled sample coordinates.
Outgoing interpolation uses left point, exact knot selects new point, endpoint holding/read-disabled fallback matches Automation.swift.
Gain evaluates in dB before conversion to amplitude; pan evaluates before mono equal-power or stereo balance conversion. Prepared buffers are shared by playback and offline render.
Automation editor uses local lane copies; Cancel only dismisses. Apply validates then uses candidate Project and remember/changed path. Full project undo/redo retains lane data.
Tempo/signature editing validates candidate and updates musical anchors before applying; sample lengths are not stretched.
limits: Source review only for editor interaction; actual GUI apply/cancel/undo remains root-owned verification.
No independent claim about AVAudioEngine final mixer arithmetic or DAC output.
DAWproject self-roundtrip and XSD tests are application/format checks, not successful import by Cubase.
DAWproject importer requires explicit RealPoint interpolation because pinned format documentation says omitted hold while reviewed Cubase boundary appears omitted linear.
